text.description_html:
Omnia 982/LP Prodigy Sub Rose Cassette Lever Strength:

Omnia Prodigy Series sub-rose assembly feature self-aligning thru-bolts and fits a standard 2-1/8" bore hole. Lever strength spring assisted inside and outside, for Door Levers only (Not for use with Door Knobs). For use with passage functions.

Sold Individually
